name: study 176, the map and the blind draw in one folder: A draws laws blind as 174 did, ten new batches of 1,000; the focus maps the study's best laws one at a time from its first scoring law, its neighbours and seeds in group N and its depth in group D; and a seed from any bundle of the same science puts that bundle's scoring laws and GG regions into the study before or while it runs
question: The operator's question (2026-10-13): can simple local rules make a graph grow a real dimension, like space; which keep one they are given; and can the null map predict a law before it runs? Study 169 is the first study on the final probes, the installed table and the deterministic fleet (800 to 806), run on 813, its data the first clean data (the operator, 2026-11-19 21:11: "This way, we immediately have clean data from our latest codebase").

decided.why_now: the operator, 2026-11-25 09:42: "We've learned plenty from 174 and 175 to warrant 176 with the triple mapper in place from the start, technically a simple hierarchy of 3, the blind mass guesses, the first filters, and the absolute top end pusher for higher N til memory limit hit"; 11:06: "lets design study 176 that we seed with the existing top scoring ggs+overall map space so far, and then again same 10 batches of 1k laws each"
decided.blind: A is 174's design on ten new search seeds: the same grid, starts, ladder, budgets and gates, a batch of 1,000 laws each; its seeds are the ten blind ones 176 drew at 2026-11-24T17:00:58Z, never run
decided.focus: the focus (operations/focus.py, resources/readings/focus_plan_1.json) is begun by the study's start: its three campaigns N (neighbours), S (seeds, group N) and D (depth) made at once, the first law taken the moment one scores, nothing to press
decided.seed: the seeded campaign starts empty and draws nothing; the Map page's "seed from a bundle" (POST /api/focus, do seed, operations/study_seed.py) puts into it every law a bundle of the same science scores above zero, its spec whole, and joins the bundle's GG regions to the focus's with their numbers, kinds and ranges; a second seed appends. Its gates record starts_alike and nothing_read only, as the focus's neighbours do, so no seeded law is stopped on a judgment its first run passed
decided.groups: A 2, N 1, D 1, the focus's plan; a split the operator set is never reset
decided.gates: 174's, unless the 40 laws run on in 174 (864) say otherwise before 176 starts: the design is then written again, since a criterion is never revised after its run started
decided.seeds: the eleven search seeds 176 drew with Python's secrets.randbits(63) at 2026-11-24T17:00:58Z: the first ten for A, the eleventh for the seeded campaign, which draws nothing
